item.title: Convenient auto-command for vim.pack.update
item.author: Michael Park
item.description: Neovim 0.12's new built-in package management is a breath of fresh air, but the default confirmation buffer is a bit bare-bones when it comes to quick interactions. If you're like me and want to just hit a key to sync everything up instead of using the code action ca and selecting update on each package...

item.title: Updating Treesitter's Config to use Main
item.author: Michael Park
item.description: If you woke up to the news that treesitter has set their default branch to main from the now frozen master then you may wish to know how to now configure your plugins that depend on it in neovim. Here's how I did it in my local dotfiles.

item.title: Treesitter Highlights for Jenkinsfile
item.author: Michael Park
item.description: Ever wanted syntax in neovim for Jenkinsfiles? Let's create an autocommand to do just that!
